title: Achieving Socio-Economic Parity through the Lens of EU AI Act
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI fairness and socio-economic status (SES) within the context of the EU AI Act and legal anti-discrimination frameworks. While it discusses the ethical implications of unfair treatment, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or specific ethical reasoning dilemmas, but rather proposes a technical fairness metric based on distributive justice principles.
